summary: Applied data professional with experience building reliable analytical pipelines, evaluated predictive models and clear decision-support tools across operational and product settings. Combines structured problem framing, careful validation and concise communication to move work from raw data to practical use without overstating results or hiding limitations.

skills.items: Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Git and Bash
forecasting, regression, classification, clustering, cross-validation and calibration
ETL, orchestration, relational databases, data-quality checks and schema validation
CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, dashboards, documentation and stakeholder communication

bullets: Built a repeatable forecasting workflow from operational data, benchmarked candidate methods on held-out periods and documented the assumptions used in monthly planning.
Automated validation and reporting checks, reducing manual preparation time and giving stakeholders a clearer view of missing, stale and inconsistent inputs.
Created compact dashboards and written summaries that translated model behaviour into concrete planning decisions for non-technical colleagues.
Partnered with software engineers to define input contracts, resolve pipeline failures and improve the reliability of recurring analytical outputs.
Developed Python and SQL transformations for scheduled data pipelines and added checks for schema drift, duplicate records and failed loads.
Worked with analysts and software engineers to trace data issues, improve documentation and stabilise recurring production jobs.
Migrated manual spreadsheet logic into governed transformations with reviewable code and repeatable test data.
Prepared and analysed survey and operational data for a service-planning study, comparing statistical baselines and tree-based models.
Produced concise technical notes and presentation materials for an interdisciplinary audience.

education.details: Modules included predictive modelling, data management, optimisation and decision analytics.
Focus areas included statistics, numerical methods and probability.
